title: cistus × nigricans var. longifolius
intro: Cistus × nigricans var. longifolius, commonly known as Long-Leafed Rock Rose, is a hybrid plant species within the Cistus genus. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a valuable remedy for various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Long-Leafed Rock Rose include soothing skin irritations, wound healing, and treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
